name: @hafley66/grapht-layout-grid-wasm
description: Deterministic Rust/Wasm grid layout executed in a worker

scripts.receipts: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --manifest-path Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && mkdir -p wasm && cp target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/grapht_layout_wasm.wasm wasm/grapht_layout_wasm.wasm
